status_at_freeze: No Super User event file has been downloaded, inspected, featurized, trained, or tested in this project.
candidate_definition: directed user pair with at least one event in [cutoff-24h, cutoff)
target_definition: same directed pair has at least one event in [cutoff, cutoff+24h)
folds: five expanding temporal folds; test starts at 50, 60, 70, 80, and 90 percent of eligible daily cutoffs and spans the next 10 percent; immediately preceding 5 percent calibration and preceding 5 percent tuning; every label window must end before the next partition starts
hyperparameters: For each fold, tune one baseline LightGBM configuration with 16 Optuna trials using only train and tuning intervals; reuse that fixed configuration for every model and seed in the fold.
calibration_and_threshold: Probability calibration and F1 threshold use only the calibration interval. Test labels are not used for model, hyperparameter, ensemble, threshold, or subgroup selection.
primary_hypothesis: Recency-type experts improve average precision over Baseline Full LightGBM on all 24h candidates.
primary_success_rule: Paired 7-day block bootstrap 95% interval for seed-averaged AP difference is entirely above zero, and mean five-fold F1 is no more than 0.005 below baseline.
secondary_hypotheses: Two-stage activity-choice improves AP over baseline.
The combined two-stage recency-type experts improve AP over baseline.
uncertainty: paired 7-day time-block bootstrap with 1000 replicates after averaging the three seed scores; primary comparison is experts versus baseline; secondary intervals are labeled exploratory
test_access_policy: Training writes frozen test scores but no test metric. The final reporting command may be run once after all 15 fold-seed runs, and its first completed report is retained with code and data hashes.
scope: Within-domain Super User training and untouched external confirmation of structures designed on MathOverflow and AskUbuntu; not zero-shot transfer and not a GNN comparison.
